mstts:express-as.prosody: Have you ever felt that quiet voice inside telling you you’re just not quite enough? Maybe it’s whispered that you could be smarter, prettier, or more successful. We all know that feeling, don’t we? Those persistent doubts can really shape the way we see ourselves—and sometimes, they even build invisible walls that keep us from real joy and fulfillment. Together, we’re about to step into a world Sharon Jaynes brings to life in her book, Enough: Silencing the Lies That Steal Your Confidence. She invites us to take a closer look at those sneaky, limiting beliefs—where they come from, and how they quietly steal our confidence. But here’s the good news: this journey isn’t about chasing perfection. Instead, it’s about discovering the value and confidence that are already within us—just waiting to be uncovered. We’ll explore stories, reflect on powerful truths, and find practical steps to break free from those old narratives. As we peel away the layers of doubt, we’ll open up new possibilities for living with authenticity and courage. So, are you ready to walk this path together? Let’s get started, and see what kind of freedom and confidence are waiting on the other side.
